capabilities: Search and discuss Markdown notes with a connected model
Create and edit notes through reviewed, undoable actions
Reference notes, folders, tags, UNreader entries, and UNmemos cards
Read EPUB/FB2/MOBI/AZW3/TXT ebooks and fetch web pages as Markdown
Manage UNreader and UNmemos data through their automation APIs
extras: Source-available license (UNcore Source Available License), not open source; commercial use, modification, and redistribution require written permission. API keys stay in device Keychain by default, with an opt-in synced plaintext fallback. UI and docs are bilingual English/Chinese. Vault search covers Markdown only; no PDF, Office, image, or DRM ebook reading.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to question your notes with your own AI model account while controlling exactly which file changes it may make.

relations.evidence: With current UNreader, UNagent can manage feeds and articles, read/star/save state, books and shelf categories
UNmemos management now includes permanent deletion by exact memo ID, in addition to search, creation, editing
For Codex or Claude Code on the same computer, open Settings → UNagent → Connections
The optional WeChat connection is configured under Settings → UNagent → Connections → WeChat connection on a computer

requires.name: Model provider API key (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, or OpenAI Responses)
UNagent Connect 0.2.1 package with Node.js 22.13+ for Codex/Claude Code pairing
WeChat (ClawBot) via a desktop computer running Obsidian

summary: AI assistant that searches, understands, and updates Obsidian notes through your own model provider, with review cards and approval modes for file changes.
